car.model_year_or_refresh: 2022-2023 (pre-Highland refresh: round steering wheel, chrome-delete window trim)

exterior.wheels: Dark-finish multi-spoke alloy wheels (reference shots show two closely related sport designs — an open turbine-spoke wheel and a denser aero-spoke wheel), low-profile tires, red brake calipers visible behind the spokes
exterior.front_end: Smooth, closed-off front fascia with no visible upper grille opening; slim full-width LED headlight strips flanking a low, sloped hood; narrow lower bumper intake vents; centered Tesla 'T' badge on the nose
exterior.profile: Low, coupe-like fastback sedan silhouette with a sloping roofline, short front overhang, flush door handles, and a subtle character line running along the lower doors
exterior.roof: Full-length glass panoramic roof panel with black trim and pillars, no visible seams, rails, or sunroof opening
exterior.badging: Tesla 'T' logo centered on the front nose; 'TESLA' wordmark badge centered on the rear trunk lid; full-width red LED tail light bar connecting the rear lamps; no separate trim badge visible

interior.steering: Traditional round two-spoke steering wheel (not a yoke) with a centered Tesla 'T' badge and physical scroll-wheel/button controls on each spoke
interior.dash: Minimalist dashboard with no analog gauge cluster in front of the driver; wide horizontal 15-inch landscape center touchscreen mounted mid-dash; light-toned horizontal trim strip spanning the dash width
interior.seats: Front bucket seats with visible bolstering and stitching, light/cream upholstery shown in the reference image
interior.ambient: Predominantly black dash, door trim, and headliner contrasted with the light-toned dash trim strip and seat upholstery; no ambient lighting strip visible in the reference images

signature_behavior.acceleration: instant, silent, head-snapping launch — this is the story's 'leap'
signature_behavior.sound: near-silent; motor whine + tire/wind noise, no engine roar
signature_behavior.startup: no key; wakes silently, screen lights up
